        return
    N = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    L = int(data[2])
    R = int(data[3])
    cells = N * M
    base = R - L + 1
    exponent = cells

    if cells % 2 == 1:
        print(result)
        return
    if (R - L) % 2 == 0:
        result = (result + 1) % MOD
    result = (result * ((MOD + 1) // 2)) % MOD
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
